objective: Retire IGPAT across Android/Web and existing older clients, preserve historical media and all non-IGPAT Community/Marites functionality.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main read and verified at 59e4c1dff5200eec72a37ec065ecacbc23f0fe99. Live BUKLOD Connect SQL migration 20261111151816 retire_igpat_preserve_history_v1 applied and inspected: eight retired RPCs no anonymous/authenticated EXECUTE, insert/update trigger enabled, 6 historical posts unchanged (5 visible). No exact OTA/artifact/device production verification; UI changes remain on DEV branch only.
chosenApproach: Redirect all IGPAT watch/create/reels/deep links to Community Wall, hide public entry points, deactivate legacy preview mounts without deleting their code, and apply a reversible server-side INSERT/reclassification trigger plus revoke authenticated reel RPC rights. Retain existing IGPAT rows, media paths, interactions and unrelated post/Marites video flows.
selectionRationale: Leaving only the button hidden would let old clients continue writing. Dropping tables or deleting old reels risks losing data. Inert client routes plus server enforcement is safely reversible without introducing native modules.
alternativeApproaches: Hide IGPAT shortcut only: rejected; older binaries, deep links, and versioned publish RPCs remain active
Delete all reel rows and functions: rejected; destructive to users and migration dependencies
Dedicated route retirement and non-destructive server-side privilege/trigger block: selected
